p: Attribute to mark classes as panels that can be dynamically discovered and loaded. Used for the plugin system and automatic panel registration.
(string) : The unique identifier for this panel
(string) : The display name shown in the UI
(string) : The icon identifier for this panel (from Icons class or font awesome)
(PanelPosition) : The default position where this panel should appear
(bool) : Whether this panel is visible by default
(float) : The default width for side panels or height for top/bottom panels
(float) : The minimum size this panel can be resized to
(int) : The order priority for this panel (lower numbers appear first)
(bool) : Whether this panel can be closed by the user
(bool) : Whether this panel supports being moved to different positions
